title: When Losing a Game Ends in Tears | Parenting Rewind
description:
The game was fun until somebody else won. A practical pause-and-rewind response for parents.

General parenting education; every child and family is different.
audience_intent: Adults and parents; not directed to children
education_scope: General parenting education only; not personalised therapy, diagnosis, or medical advice.

narration.transcript: The game was fun until somebody else won. Calling the reaction silly adds shame to disappointment. Before reacting, pause for one breath so the next words can be short, clear, and useful. Name the feeling and hold the rule: You wanted to win; it is okay to be upset, and the pieces stay on the table. Children can learn to lose without liking it; model calm, protect the game, and praise recovery.

source.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
source.title: Tips for Creating Rules

claim_limits: The suggested wording is an example, not a guarantee.
Families should adapt expectations to age, development, safety and individual needs.
